messages.content: I have approval to reserve the Atlanta hotel now. Compare the summit property with the Hyatt Place for Sunday and Monday nights, including every required charge.

The summit hotel is $189 per night, plus $50.36 in taxes, for $428.36 total. There is no mandatory destination fee. Hyatt Place is $139 per night, plus $40.20 in taxes, for $318.20 total, also with no required property fee. Hyatt Place saves $110.16.
What do I give up besides being outside the meeting hotel? Check breakfast and Tuesday luggage too.

The summit hotel connects directly to the meeting rooms by an indoor passage, but its rate does not include breakfast. Hyatt Place includes breakfast for one registered guest. It is about a six-minute outdoor walk from the summit venue. Both front desks confirmed complimentary luggage storage after Tuesday checkout, so you can collect your bag before going to ATL.
And the payment and cancellation terms? I do not want the cheaper number hiding a fee or an early charge.

The summit rate is charged at checkout and can be canceled without penalty until 6:00 p.m. local time Saturday; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. Hyatt Place must be reserved by 8:00 p.m. Eastern today. Its full $318.20 is charged when booked and becomes nonrefundable immediately. Neither quote adds a booking fee.
The agenda is firm, and the breakfast plus $110 savings outweigh the short walk. Reserve Hyatt Place for one adult, Sunday and Monday nights. Do not ticket the flights as part of this.

Before I submit it: this will charge $318.20 now and cannot be canceled or changed for a refund. The reservation will cover two nights, checking out Tuesday, with breakfast and post-checkout luggage storage included. Shall I proceed on those terms?
Yes, proceed with the hotel only.

Hyatt Place Midtown is reserved for one adult for Sunday and Monday nights at a prepaid, nonrefundable total of $318.20. Confirmation: ATL-HP-78426. Breakfast is included, and Tuesday luggage storage is noted. The selected Sunday 4:35 p.m. and Tuesday 7:40 p.m. flights remain unticketed.
